script_package.title: Dexter's Lab: Urban Brainrot Brew
script_package.description: Watch Dexter cook up some mad science with a roadman twist! Pure urban brainrot, fam.
script_package.spoken_script: Yo, check the drip, fam. Dexter's in the lab, moving mad scientist ting. These calculations don't lie, bruv. We're about to cook up something proper vexed, on my life. Opps ain't ready for this formula, trust. They're gonna be washed when this drops. This ain't no cap, this is pure finesse. My beakers are bubbling, the whole block's gonna feel this. You thought your mandem were smart? Nah, we're on another level. This potion's gonna have everyone moving like they've seen a ghost. Pure chaos, fam. You can't even comprehend the levels. My brain's too big for your small-time schemes. Get ready for the ultimate drop, it's gonna be legendary.

scenes.headline: The Lab Flex
scenes.supporting_text: Emphasize the contrast between the high-tech lab and the roadman persona.
scenes.narration_text: Dexter, the ultimate roadman scientist, is in his element, flexing his lab setup and hyping up his latest creation.
scenes.action_prompt: Close-up shot of the Uploaded Character, Dexter, wearing oversized lab goggles and a pristine lab coat, confidently gesturing with a gloved hand towards a complex array of bubbling beakers and flashing scientific equipment. He has a cocky smirk, and his eyes dart conspiratorially to the camera. The lab is dimly lit with neon green and purple hues.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Dexter: "Yo, check the drip, fam. Dexter's in the lab, moving mad scientist ting. These calculations don't lie, bruv. We're about to cook up something proper vexed, on my life."
scenes.negative_prompt: boring lab, no character expression, clean white lab, generic science
scenes.style_notes: Maintain the cartoonish, exaggerated style of Dexter's Lab with urban elements.
scenes.visual_query: cinematic close-up of Dexter in a futuristic lab, neon lights, bubbling chemicals, confident expression

scenes.headline: The Escalation
scenes.supporting_text: Show the mixture reacting violently, hinting at its potency.
scenes.narration_text: Dexter escalates the stakes, boasting about his formula's power and the chaos it's about to unleash on his 'opps'.
scenes.action_prompt: Medium shot of the Uploaded Character, Dexter, intensely stirring a glowing, viscous liquid in a large beaker with a comically oversized stirring rod. His expression is a mix of intense focus and mischievous glee. Sparks fly from the mixture, and a dramatic plume of purple smoke billows upwards. He glances at the camera with a knowing look.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Dexter: "Opps ain't ready for this formula, trust. They're gonna be washed when this drops. This ain't no cap, this is pure finesse. My beakers are bubbling, the whole block's gonna feel this."
scenes.negative_prompt: calm reaction, no visual effects, bland lab equipment
scenes.camera_style: medium shot, slight zoom, handheld chaos
scenes.style_notes: Keep the visual effects vibrant and exaggerated, matching the cartoonish tone.
scenes.visual_query: medium shot of Dexter stirring a glowing chemical mixture, dramatic smoke, mischievous expression

scenes.headline: The Confrontation
scenes.supporting_text: The vial glows intensely, drawing attention to the final product.
scenes.narration_text: Dexter confronts his unseen rivals, declaring his superior intellect and the mind-bending effects of his new potion.
scenes.action_prompt: Dynamic shot of the Uploaded Character, Dexter, holding up a small, glowing vial of the finished concoction, presenting it triumphantly to the camera. His eyes are wide with manic energy, and he's practically vibrating with excitement. Behind him, a complex machine hums loudly, ready for deployment. He gestures wildly with his free hand.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Dexter: "You thought your mandem were smart? Nah, we're on another level. This potion's gonna have everyone moving like they've seen a ghost. Pure chaos, fam."
scenes.negative_prompt: still shot, no energy, boring vial, simple background
scenes.style_notes: Emphasize Dexter's over-the-top personality and the absurdity of the situation.
scenes.visual_query: dynamic shot of Dexter holding a glowing vial, manic expression, complex machinery in background

scenes.headline: The Ultimate Drop
scenes.supporting_text: The sip is tiny but the reaction is massive.
scenes.narration_text: Dexter delivers the ultimate payoff, hinting at the incomprehensible power of his creation and preparing for a legendary reveal.
scenes.action_prompt: Extreme close-up on the Uploaded Character, Dexter's, face, his eyes gleaming with pure, unadulterated 'brainrot' energy. He winks conspiratorially at the camera, then quickly takes a tiny, theatrical sip from the glowing vial. His eyes widen even further, and he makes a comically exaggerated 'mind blown' expression, before a quick cut to black.
scenes.audio_dialogue_cue: Dexter: "You can't even comprehend the levels. My brain's too big for your small-time schemes. Get ready for the ultimate drop, it's gonna be legendary."
scenes.negative_prompt: subtle reaction, long shot, no facial expression, dull lighting
scenes.camera_style: extreme close-up, quick cut, jump cut
scenes.style_notes: End with a visually striking and humorous punchline, leaving the audience wanting more.
scenes.visual_query: extreme close-up of Dexter's face, winking, sipping glowing vial, exaggerated reaction, quick cut to black
